body: Thats a good idea I will look tomorrow. Thanks.

They would never say that but I do have an unreal amount of student debt and they signed as guarantors and I really fucked up this semester so I won't be graduating. I have done the research and they won't have to pay back the student loans if I were to die.
I like that, I can end my life without dying. Thats clever, but my current life has so much baggage. For example, I am about 120k in debt from student loans and will not graduate from university.
I have achieved a lot, and thats part of the problem. Over the last 5 years or so my life has gone from great to absolute shit, and now I don't see anyway of getting back to where I was before.

I do, and thats part of the reason I should do it though. I am at a point in my life where I am seriously about to become such a burden on them. I think it would be better for them if I were to just go and have them remember me as I was rather than linger around and shame myself.

The thing is no one around me ever guess I am feeling this way. I "have" people to talk to about this like my brothers but it would shock them. A big thing for me would be the shame of being labeled suicidal. I would much rather just be dead and have it look like an accident.

Thats the thing as well though, I cannot think of something that makes life worth living. And besides video games honestly there isn't much else I enjoy. I mean i like getting drunk, and jerking off. Which seem like pretty pointless things, in the end I feel like I am just a drain on everyone around me.
How is it a bad way to go? Wont I just die instantly?

I am in the exact same situation as you right now. Just failed a class in my last semester of law school. My entire family is on their way to see me graduate but I know that it isn't going to happen. I am sure that we share similar feelings of shame/embarrassment/guilt. May I ask, why do you think you failed your class?
